card.name: Linking words before "total"
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "the", "to" right where the next word is likely "total" or "energy". Most often "of" after a percentage, as in "20% of".

modes.label: Percent of total
modes.description: The word "of" directly after a percentage, before total energy or total amount.
modes.example: kept to “20% to 35%<< of>> total energy intake.”

modes.label: Other links before total
modes.description: "the", "to" or "bring" in a sum, subtraction or proportion where "total" comes next.
modes.example: from<< the>> total oral levodopa dose in mill

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "total" (in English and Chinese) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the little word before "total", mostly "of" after a percentage.
